beaches.name: Haulover Beach (clothing-optional section)
beaches.summary: Nude use is accepted on the northern one-third of the beach, towers #12 to #16. Miami-Dade County's park page lists this section as its Clothing Optional Beach, where visitors swim and sunbathe without clothing; the rest of the beach is swimwear use. Volunteer beach ambassadors on the section provide information about etiquette.
